scope: Publicly discoverable GitHub repositories plus official Gopher and SnappySnap documentation; a source/documentation review, not a live comparative benchmark.
verdict: One of the most comprehensive toolkits is supportable; unique overall capability leadership or feature-superset status is not established.
method: Paginated repository search includes forks; private results are excluded.
Read default-branch commit and recursive tree; deduplicate identical tree IDs for scope reporting.
Retrieve bounded source, registration and relevant documentation files; verify Git blob hashes; statically index declarations and inspect selected dispatch paths.
Never execute, install or import competitor code. Source declarations and author-reported live evidence remain distinct from reproduced tests.
Counts are not normalized capability scores; consolidated tools, aliases, disabled registrations, mocks, unavailable APIs and placeholders prevent a meaningful raw ranking.
limitations: Search is bounded by public discoverability, metadata, indexes, default branches and retrieval time. No claim to every private, unindexed, commercial or later implementation.
Targeted review depth varies. All tree-screened candidates received file/registration screening; only selected projects received deeper source/documentation review.
Source files above 700000 bytes, dependency/build/test directories and binary assets were excluded from the text index. No third-party code is redistributed here.
Not every registered operation, branch, release, host build or plugin version was audited or run. No comparative musical-quality benchmark was performed.
SyncFL counts describe its source baseline and recorded calibration, not new live verification performed during this comparison.

external_documentation.name: Image-Line Gopher controls
external_documentation.observation: Official experimental DAW actions cover transport, channels, mixer, plugins and scripts; this does not establish a supported external MCP endpoint.

external_documentation.name: SnappySnap manual
external_documentation.observation: Commercial plugin host with MCP parameters, snapshots, morphing and randomization; complementary plugin scope, not whole-FL project control. Documentation-only review.
